notes: The tuition fee of 1,500 EUR per semester is stated for non-EU applicants for this specific programme. The semester contribution of about 155 EUR is separate and applies to all students. Rules for language proficiency list only tests named in the quote; other accepted tests (PTE, Cambridge, UNIcert, telc) are omitted for brevity but are listed on the page.
